overview_description.description: Model ML offers an AI-native workspace tailored for financial institutions such as investment banks, private equity firms, and consultancies. The company provides purpose-built AI agents that analyse structured and unstructured finance data, including emails, filings, CRM records, and third-party datasets, to automate research, reporting, and document generation. Its “AI Modules” feature enables users to design autonomous workflows that run continuously, generating deliverables like pitch decks or earnings summaries with embedded institutional formatting. The platform operates securely and supports single-tenant deployment in a client’s cloud environment to preserve data privacy and compliance.
